anti_loop_signal.reason: The claim is tightly scoped to RSP-16, excludes real migration/full revival, and the portability probe is fixture-only. These are healthy anti-loop signals. The loop risk now is regenerating evidence without expanding the leak-scan coverage to the full public surface.

user_intent_alignment: The implementation aligns with the bounded verification and public/private separation intent, and it does not claim to have migrated private identity. It partially aligns with real cross-machine migration because only synthetic fixture migration is verified; actual migration remains an explicit human decision boundary, which is acceptable if the claim stays scoped.
